custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two vendors, vendor A and vendor B.
  • Create a special-order part number for this test that the test location ordered from vendor A first and from vendor B second, but received from vendor B first at a cost of $12.00 and from vendor A last at a cost of $15.00, all within the last 12 months, so vendor A made the most recent delivery.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make vendor B: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 VENDOR B in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  3. Make a work order for the special order: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 LINE S in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573674-SO in Part Number and pick Add new special order part, type a Description, 1 in Quantity, pick vendor A under Vendor and type a Cost, then click Save Part, and order it. Do the same again with vendor B. Receive vendor B's first at Cost 12.00, then vendor A's at Cost 15.00, each on the Receive screen (Purchase Orders in the left menu, Receive on its row, Vendor Invoice #, Invoice Date, Qty received, then the Receive Parts button).
  4. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  5. Make a work order for the special order: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 LINE S in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573674-SO in Part Number and pick Add new special order part, type a Description, 1 in Quantity, pick vendor A under Vendor and type a Cost, then click Save Part; order it and receive it from vendor A on the Receive screen (Purchase Orders in the left menu, Receive on its row, Vendor Invoice #, Invoice Date, Qty received, then the Receive Parts button).
  6. The same way, with the number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573674-ORD, but do not receive it.
  7. Switch to location B: Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  8. Make work order 2: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 LINE 2 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
